host_profile.profiling_note: Host waits include pending GPU execution and synchronization; these are not measured data-copy or GPU kernel times. CPU graph building and async submission overlap GPU work; total host boundaries describe where this thread spends wall time.

native_readiness.scope: Warm native full-output engine and attributed-span construction; excludes exported terminology lookup, ASR, app IPC and UI. No reference-context prompt or Qwen model parity is claimed.

decision.basert: Not adopted: no evidence for 300 ms complete-output tail; wording/semantic divergence; native redistribution license separate. Prefix/no-prefix diagnostic outputs are identical, not proof of identical operators to MLX.
decision.read_batch_each_submit: Rejected: full paired ordinary English outputs equal but median latency worsens.
decision.submission_batch: Rejected: full paired outputs equal but median and tail latency worsen.
decision.mixed_mlp3bit: Rejected: lossy recompression changes meanings despite the same aggregate lexical pass count.
decision.host_profile: Diagnostic only: host submission duration includes runtime scheduling and waiting, not isolated transfer or GPU kernel timing.
decision.native_readiness: Prepared and compiled with SDK 27.0; native language assets are not installed. No native translations or downloads attempted.
